text: Wallpaper background（DSH 插件，Web 客户端）：为 DSH Web 的页面背景轮换显示精选壁纸，并让应用的基础表面保持半透明，使图片透出。插件通过 Web 客户端样式和背景图 CSS 变量应用效果，图片会随机切换，默认每 20 秒更换一次；用户可在设置面板关闭效果或调整间隔。设置卡片还提供手动或定期检查更新的选项，并在发现新提交时显示更新命令。适合希望为 DSH Web 页面更换背景、同时保留现有主题界面的用户。壁纸图片从 images.unsplash.com 加载；启用更新检查时会向 api.github.com 查询公开仓库提交，不需要 API Key。

Wallpaper background adds rotating images to the DSH Web page, visible through translucent surfaces. Images switch every 20 seconds by default. The settings panel controls rotation and optional update checks. Images load from images.unsplash.com; checks query api.github.com. No API key is needed.
想让 DSH Web 页面背景自动轮换壁纸。
如何给 DSH 网页界面换一张会定时切换的背景图？
I want a rotating wallpaper behind the DSH web interface.
Wallpaper background 的功能「自动轮播网页壁纸」：在 DSH Web 页面显示从预设图片中随机选择的背景，并按设置的秒数定时切换；关闭功能或卸载时会移除样式和计时器。
Wallpaper background 的功能「背景与更新设置卡片」：在插件列表中提供启用开关、轮播间隔、更新检查开关与间隔，可暂存、保存或放弃设置，并显示可用更新及对应命令。
Wallpaper background 使用前须知：背景图片会从 images.unsplash.com 加载；这是公开图片 CDN 请求。
Wallpaper background 使用前须知：启用更新检查时，浏览器会向 api.github.com 查询仓库最新提交；该功能不需要 API Key。

@imcp-pro/dsh-client-background README · Features：- **100 curated wallpapers** rotate on a configurable interval.
- **Runtime switch** — disable the effect without uninstalling the plugin.
- **Client-side update check** — polls GitHub for a newer commit and surfaces the exact update command.
- **No framework coupling** — the visual effect uses only browser globals (`document`, `Image`, `setInterval`).

@imcp-pro/dsh-client-background README · Requirements：- A dsh `web` profile (`dsh --profile web`, a.k.a. `dsh web`) with the `web-app` bundle.
- A dsh build that exposes the base theme tokens `--dsw-alias-bg-base` / `--dsw-specific-sidebar-fill`, toggles the `body[data-ds-dark-theme]` dark-mode attribute, and serves the Plugins settings panel.

@imcp-pro/dsh-client-background README · Themes：The effect adapts to the active dsh theme — translucent white surfaces in light mode, translucent dark surfaces in dark mode — so it follows your theme (and system) automatically. **Dark mode is recommended**: the photo reads as a moody, high-contrast backdrop. In light mode the photo shows through a white veil with a slight darkening and looks more subdued.

@imcp-pro/dsh-client-background README · From GitHub：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:imcp-pro/dsh-client-background
```

The plugin's `prepare` script builds `lib/` at install time (it is not committed), and pnpm ≥ 10 blocks a git dependency's build scripts until allowlisted. The first run may therefore fail with `ERR_PNPM_GIT_DEP_PREPARE_NOT_ALLOWED` — that is expected. To resolve it:

@imcp-pro/dsh-client-background README · From GitHub：1. Copy the exact allowlist key printed under **"For example"** in the error:
   `@imcp-pro/dsh-client-background@https://codeload.github.com/…/tar.gz/<commit>`.
2. Paste it under `allowBuilds` in the web profile's `pnpm-workspace.yaml`
   (`~/.dsh/profiles/web/pnpm-workspace.yaml`), then re-run the command.

```yaml

@imcp-pro/dsh-client-background README · ~/.dsh/profiles/web/pnpm-workspace.yaml：allowBuilds:
  "@imcp-pro/dsh-client-background@https://codeload.github.com/imcp-pro/dsh-client-background/tar.gz/<commit>": true
```

> **Note:** the key is commit-bound — every new commit changes `<commit>`, so always copy the key from the current error. Keep the codeload tarball form (`https://codeload.github.com/…/tar.gz/<commit>`) verbatim, not `git+https://` or `git+ssh://`.

@imcp-pro/dsh-client-background README · From an agent (dsh / Claude Code / OpenCode)：Paste the following prompt into your agent; it installs the plugin and resolves the allowlist step for you:

Install the dsh background plugin for the web profile:

@imcp-pro/dsh-client-background README · From a local checkout：```sh
npm run build
dsh plugin --profile web add .
```

Then restart `dsh web`; the background appears and persists across restarts.

@imcp-pro/dsh-client-background README · Configuration：Open **Settings → Plugins → Plugin list**, then expand **Wallpaper background** under **Global plugins**:

| Field | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Enable background | on | runtime off switch; the plugin stays installed |
| Rotation interval (seconds) | 20 | how often the image auto-switches |
| Check for updates | off | periodically poll GitHub for a newer commit |
| Check interval (seconds) | 21600 | time between two update checks |

@imcp-pro/dsh-client-background README · Configuration：Edits stage locally and apply on **Save**; **Discard** drops them. When a newer commit is found, the entry shows the update command to run (then restart).

@imcp-pro/dsh-client-background README · Development：```sh
npm install
npm run build   # esbuild bundles + tsc declarations → lib/
npm test        # vitest (jsdom)
```

`tsconfig.json` maps the `@deepseek-ai/dsh-*` type imports to a sibling deepseek-harness source checkout (its `lib/types`), because the published dsh packages currently predate the source API this plugin targets. Point the `paths` entries at your own checkout before building.

@imcp-pro/dsh-client-background README · Publishing：```sh
npm publish    # `prepare` runs the build; ships lib/ + cordis.patch.yml
```

The package ships `lib/` and `cordis.patch.yml`. It declares `dsh.bundle.patch` (so `dsh plugin add` registers the layer), `dsh.client` (so the client-modules host serves the browser half), and a `client-background` settings namespace the Host half registers.
